title: Digital IDs Reached 250 Checkpoints While Most States Lagged
hook: Digital IDs reached 250 airport checkpoints, but most states still lag.
closing: Your phone is replacing airport plastic slowly, so carry both for now.
question: Have you tried a digital ID?

segments.say: Digital ID acceptance reached 20 states. The rollout nearly doubled, but still misses most of the country.
Digital IDs reached 250 checkpoints. Airport acceptance expanded almost tenfold in one year.
Only 20 states accept digital IDs. Most travelers still cannot rely on a phone alone.
